full_name: Ruth Milkman | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2012–2013 Social Sciences Matina S. Horner Distinguished Visiting Professor City University of New York
bio: Ruth Milkman is a professor of sociology at the Graduate Center of the City University of New York and the academic director of its Joseph S. Murphy Institute for Worker Education and Labor Studies. Her research focuses on work and organized labor in the United States. She has published extensively on low-wage immigrant workers in the United States, analyzing employment conditions and the dynamics of immigrant labor organizing.
